title: Vacuous foreign-seed assertion in announce store tamper test
description: announce_store.rs store_rejects_tamper_and_wrong_sealing_seed tampers the state record and never restores it before the foreign-seed (seed 0x43) assertion. The tampered record fails signature verification for ANY seed, so foreign.load() == Err(Corrupt) passes even if sealing were not bound to the node seed at all — the test proves nothing about seed binding. Fix: restore the original record (write_record_raw) or use fresh roots before the foreign-seed check. Found by correctness codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-12zy.
